title: A Summit for the Passage
author: Paloma Whitlock
blurb: Sebastian Fairweather, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
